reasoning: The orchestrator improves its own repository: it extends the healthcheck API, improves the rendering of wave statuses in the Streamlit UI, runs checks and delivers the changes via a Pull Request.

tasks.title: Git Sync: clone agent-orchestrator-lite
tasks.prompt: Clone or update (git pull) the repository https://github.com/kartemiev/agent-orchestrator-lite into the current working directory and prepare the working environment.

tasks.title: Backend/Docs: detailed healthcheck
tasks.prompt: In the file orchestrator/main.py add a GET /health/details endpoint that returns JSON with the service status, the current UTC time and the API version. Update README.md: add a description of the new endpoint in the Gateway API section.

tasks.title: UI: improve wave status rendering
tasks.prompt: In the file ui/app.py improve the rendering of the workflow status: display a human-readable Temporal status name and a brief task summary (how many completed, how many failed). Keep the existing approve/reject button logic.

tasks.title: Tests & Verification
tasks.prompt: Run a syntax check over the Python files: python -m py_compile orchestrator/main.py orchestrator/worker.py orchestrator/workflows.py orchestrator/activities.py ui/app.py. Make sure there are no errors; fix the issues you find if any.

tasks.title: Delivery: commit, push, PR
tasks.prompt: Commit the changes with a clear message, push the current branch to origin via git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/feature/self-update and open a Pull Request from the feature/self-update branch into main with a description of the improvements.
